request.style: English, male solo, choir, harp, strings, flute, oboe, solemn, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The seventh day the wine was bright
The king commanded eunuchs to the light
To bring the queen with royal crown
To show her beauty to the town

[Verse]
But Queen Vashti refused to come
Her face against the king's command
The anger burned within his heart
A crisis at the court apart

[Verse]
He sought the wise who knew the times
To judge the matter in the lines
For it was custom for the king
To ask the laws on which he cling

[Verse]
Carshena Shethar Admatha
Tarshish Meres and Marsena
With Memucan the seven men
Holding the highest ranks again

[Verse]
Memucan spoke before the throne
The queen has wronged the king alone
But all the officials and the land
Will see her refusal in the hand

[Verse]
The women will despise their men
And speak the words of her again
So let the decree be written out
To ban her from the king's account

[Verse]
Give the position to a woman wise
Who is better in his eyes
So all the women from the least
Will honor every husband's beast

[Verse]
The advice pleased the king and all
He did as Memucan did call
And wrote the law in Persia's book
To seal the fate with iron look

[Outro]
Seven officials held the rank
